Game Modes

Three Ways to Play

Whether you crave deep narrative discovery, high-octane speedruns, or mindful relaxation, DotsPo adapts to your mood.

Narrative Chapters

Story Mode

Relive history through the eyes of world-changing innovators. Connect dots to solve milestones and unlock authentic historical artifacts and diary clues.

  • 5 Chapters & 75 levels per story
  • Milestones from 1856 to modern era
  • Archival clue gallery & diary rewards
Fast-Paced Sprint

Competitive Mode

A thrilling time-attack test of reflexes and vision. Connect 3+ dots to build massive combos, trigger the 15-second 2X multiplier frenzy, and climb leaderboards.

  • 30s core rush + 15s 2X bonus
  • Requires 3+ connected dots
  • Global high-score competition
Zen & Mindful

Endless Mode

No move limits, no ticking clocks. Just your fingertips, tranquil chimes, and a continually refreshing canvas of soothing color connections.

  • Infinite peaceful puzzle flow
  • Adaptive color balance
  • Ideal for mindful meditation
Crafted with Care

Designed for Calm and Clarity

Every detail in DotsPo is fine-tuned to deliver an engaging, mindful, and sensory experience.

Archival Story Milestones

Every level is anchored in a real historical event. Collect authentic quotes, diary entries, and invention schematics as you progress.

Calming Pentatonic Audio

Each connected dot chimes in harmonious pitch. Strings of dots create soothing melodic arcs inspired by acoustic bells and marimbas.

Tactile Precision

Designed for silky-smooth drag gestures, instant feedback, and gentle haptic pulses that make every connection deeply satisfying.

Play Anywhere Offline

No Wi-Fi required to play through chapters or relax in Endless mode. Perfect for daily commutes, flights, and quiet moments.

Mindful, Clean Aesthetic

A sanctuary for your attention. Beautiful Scandinavian typography, crisp white space, and zero aggressive ad popups.

Global Competitive Rush

Put your pattern recognition to the ultimate test in timed 30s + 15s speedruns and challenge friends on global leaderboards.
